info.name: SQL Optimizer API
info.description:
Postman setup for the SQL Optimizer backend (FastAPI + Gemini via Vertex AI).

1. Start the server: run backend\run.bat (or run_server_now.ps1).
2. Import SQL-Optimizer.postman_collection.json and SQL-Optimizer-Local.postman_environment.json.
3. Select the 'SQL Optimizer - Local' environment and hit the requests.

request.description:
MAIN ENDPOINT. Runs the Gemini multi-agent pipeline (issue finder -> planner -> rewriter).

Required body fields:
  - query: single SELECT statement (required)
  - agent_version: int >= 1 (required, else 426 OUTDATED_AGENT)

Optional: custom_request, scope, schema, explain_analyze, innodb_stats.
Send X-Device-ID header for per-device rate limiting.

Success 200: {optimized_query, actions, index_recommendations, summary, error: null, queries_used, queries_remaining}
Errors: 426 outdated agent | 429 rate limited | 503 LLM rate-limited (retryable) | 504 timeout

Full DB-backed optimization using per-request credentials.
Uses the existing issue_finder -> planner -> rewriter pipeline.
Set DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_NAME, and TEST_QUERY in this environment.
Scope: joins, indexes. Custom request: none.
Does not modify /optimize or /agent_optimize.
Password must not appear in responses or logs.
